selection_policy: Rank historical positives by concrete gain, exact-parent compatibility, bounded cost, standalone bakeability, runtime simplicity, reproducibility, regression risk, rollback, and user-facing value. Queue status is never promotion status.

trials.source_checkpoint: Phase-3 primary 19-layer model plus seed_37 and seed_49 adapters
trials.control_baseline: Phase-3 primary model; seed_49 was admitted only after positive net relative quality change
trials.preservation_result: Worst-decile quality did not regress; zero hard failures; zero critical failures; human gate PASS
trials.bakeability: Natural: average compatible dense weights in FP32 and serialize one checkpoint
trials.current_parent_compatibility: HIGH: Supa-A1.1 and Baya 1.7 have identical 310-key tensor inventories, shapes, tokenizer hash, Qwen3 topology, Nimbus base, and checkpoint-200 adapter lineage
known_negative_transfers: Convex checkpoint soups in the later long-context geometry search did not improve its then-current frontier
Arbitrary family averaging is forbidden; this trial is restricted to the same-base, same-adapter Supa/Baya dose pair
trials.reason: Frozen trial passed its transfer gate: all-256 170→173, Stability 125→129, and all-four packs 20→27. Production promotion is separately rejected because base/paraphrase both-correct packs regressed 51→42 and Showcase fell 45→44.

trials.mechanism: Bounded long-context adapter dose scaling and dense merge
trials.source_era_phase: Long-context weight geometry and Supa/Baya publication, 2026-08-26/27
trials.source_checkpoint: Nimbus 1.6 plus Halo Stage-A checkpoint-200 LoRA
trials.preservation_result: Scale 0.8125 reached 121/192 Stability and became Supa; scale 1.25 supplied complementary abstention but was weaker alone; dense parity drift was recorded
trials.artifact_type: LoRA adapter or standalone dense merge
trials.bakeability: High: exact LoRA delta can be merged into one FP16 checkpoint
trials.current_parent_compatibility: HIGH: A1.1 is the FP16 scale-0.8125 realization of this exact Nimbus/adapter lineage
known_negative_transfers: The effect is anchor-dependent; applying the transferred delta to Halo Uncensored harmed it
Continuation checkpoints, ordinary convex adapter soups, and rank pruning failed the later search gates
trials.reason: Second bounded checkpoint trial if the midpoint soup fails; 1.0625 was explicitly measured in the historical positive dose region, avoiding a new sweep.

trials.mechanism: Cross-depth scaffold restoration and global/layerwise soup coefficients
trials.source_era_phase: Teacher soup, Qwen3 Cross-Depth Soup Mini, and Layerwise Soup Lab
trials.source_checkpoint: Official Qwen3-0.6B scaffold with 19-layer Rineya donor geometry
trials.control_baseline: Official Qwen3-0.6B at 14/64 Showcase; family recipes reached 24-31/64
trials.preservation_result: R2 transfer showed abstention collapse at extreme blends; Halo-pair sealed TEST remained off
trials.bakeability: High, with existing guarded streaming merge infrastructure
trials.current_parent_compatibility: Mechanism already forms Nimbus, which is A1.1's base; repeating it on A1.1 risks circular lineage and lacks a non-arbitrary new donor
known_negative_transfers: Extreme R2 blends traded away abstention
No historical evidence selects a new layerwise donor for A1.1
trials.reason: Core family-forming mechanism already present in the A1.1 ancestry; do not create a circular, arbitrary second graft.

trials.source_checkpoint: Pulse 1.6 plus Stage-A checkpoint-200/250 adapter deltas
trials.control_baseline: Pulse baseline 31/64 Showcase; selected single negative vector reached 41/64 and 117/192 Stability
trials.preservation_result: Useful on Pulse and in routed systems; historical report explicitly says the long-context delta is anchor-dependent
trials.artifact_type: Exact LoRA-delta combination; mergeable into a dense checkpoint
trials.bakeability: High technically; scientific transfer risk is medium
trials.current_parent_compatibility: Tensor-compatible Qwen3 lineage, but not evidence-compatible: the positive result was Pulse-anchored, not Supa-anchored
known_negative_transfers: Anchor dependence is a primary historical finding
Transferred long-context deltas harmed Halo Uncensored
trials.reason: Credible large historical gain and bakeable artifact, but lower priority because its positive evidence is anchor-specific.

trials.mechanism: All-layer dense SFT for short-response behavior
trials.source_checkpoint: Original 28-layer short-response base plus dense SFT adapter
trials.control_baseline: Heuristic score 0.804 base versus 0.995 dense SFT
trials.preservation_result: No category regression above the allowed limit; completion remained 1.0; human PASS
trials.bakeability: Technically high if the exact adapter/base are recovered
trials.current_parent_compatibility: LOW: old task/lineage and training artifact absent from this worktree; A1.1 already includes later family behavior
known_negative_transfers: No evidence that replaying the early dense objective preserves A1.1 long-context behavior
trials.reason: Historically positive but not a bounded low-cost modern transfer without the exact adapter and a disjoint training/evaluation contract.

trials.mechanism: Progressive decoder-layer deletion with exhaustive recovery
trials.source_checkpoint: 28-layer short-response model reduced to a 19-layer frontier
trials.control_baseline: Full 28-layer reference; selected 19-layer frontier reported 23.75% memory gain versus 11.24% quality opportunity loss
trials.preservation_result: Human PASS for the specialized efficiency frontier; later post-alignment Phase 4B reduction was negative
trials.artifact_type: Reduced full checkpoint plus optional recovery adapter
trials.bakeability: High but changes architecture and product profile
trials.current_parent_compatibility: Algorithmically possible on A1.1, but not a quality-first improvement and requires a separately declared efficiency profile
known_negative_transfers: Additional post-alignment compression produced no positive proportional value
trials.reason: Valid historical efficiency result, but outside the immediate quality-first checkpoint objective.

trials.mechanism: Importance-guided targeted adapter recovery after structural reduction
trials.control_baseline: Unrecovered reduced checkpoint; all_remaining highest quality and top1 reduced trainable parameters by about 94.7%
trials.preservation_result: Repeated-seed review and critical cases passed human review for branch-specific DPO
trials.bakeability: High only with its exact reduced parent
trials.current_parent_compatibility: LOW: parent-specific to the old 19-layer frontier; not directly applicable to 28-layer A1.1
known_negative_transfers: Recovery effect cannot be detached from the exact deletion profile and parent
trials.reason: Positive mechanism, but the exact compatible reduced parent/adapter pair is not a modern A1.1 transfer.

trials.preservation_result: Worst-decile unchanged and recorded relative loss dimensions zero; human PASS
trials.bakeability: High if the exact parent and adapter are present
trials.current_parent_compatibility: LOW: small old-lineage effect and no exact A1.1-compatible preference adapter
known_negative_transfers: No evidence the old preference objective improves the modern long-context parent
trials.reason: Credible small historical gain, but it requires new training rather than a cheap bounded transfer.

trials.mechanism: Relevant-memory context compaction with prefix-cache consistency
trials.preservation_result: Complete relevant-memory recall, no forbidden memories selected, zero reported quality opportunity loss, prefix-cache numerical consistency PASS
trials.current_parent_compatibility: Potentially model-agnostic but requires a separate efficiency product profile and runtime integration
known_negative_transfers: The subsequent sparse-runtime extension was negative and selected dense fallback
trials.reason: Credible product-stack win, but ranked after checkpoint candidates because it cannot create the immediate standalone model.

trials.mechanism: FP16 dense storage plus model-specific constant abstention offset
trials.control_baseline: Supa-A1 BF16 store and ungated FP16 core
trials.preservation_result: FP16 matched Stability, gained two Showcase points, and reproduced the offline S4 gate on 256/256 rows; significance not claimed
trials.artifact_type: Full FP16 checkpoint plus custom/portable logit policy
trials.bakeability: Already baked as the preferred parent
known_negative_transfers: Unchanged threshold lowers Baya Showcase from 40 to 35
trials.reason: Keep as parent behavior and preservation gate; do not count it as a new transfer win.

trials.mechanism: Answer-blind UNKNOWN gates and ordered consensus cascades
trials.source_checkpoint: Multiple published Rineya cores and exact adapters
trials.control_baseline: Unmodified Nimbus 113/256 and single Supa dense core 161/256; System48 reached 176/256
trials.preservation_result: Showcase-selected, Stability-validated; substantial multi-execution latency is explicit
trials.bakeability: Cannot honestly collapse nonlinear prediction routing into one checkpoint
trials.current_parent_compatibility: Already the product-stack frontier; unsuitable as a single-checkpoint transfer parent
known_negative_transfers: System score must not be attributed to one dense model
trials.reason: Retained as a shipped system win and evaluation comparator, not a new checkpoint trial.

trials.mechanism: Multi-adapter token consensus and probability fusion
trials.source_checkpoint: Frozen v2.2 short-response backbone plus seven same-base adapters
trials.control_baseline: Hard K=7 improved the zero-scoring sealed pilot backbone, and probability mean was numerically stronger
trials.preservation_result: Did not convincingly beat the strongest single expert; full TEST calibrated fusion lost to hard voting; fixed-method v2.1.2 transfer was poor
trials.bakeability: No exact one-checkpoint equivalent for token-level nonlinear voting
trials.current_parent_compatibility: No matched A1.1 adapter committee and poor cross-corpus transfer
trials.reason: Real local system effect, but not a shipping-suitable modern checkpoint candidate.

trials.source_checkpoint: Frozen compact student plus specialist adapters

trials.preservation_result: Later Phase-9 production gate remained blocked, including zero procedure correctness in the recorded compact-student path

trials.current_parent_compatibility: LOW: different layer count/hidden size and exact selected artifacts are outside this worktree
